eps.ov: An "Undead" man with an immortal body suddenly appears in front of Fuko with the power of "Unluck".
Andy makes a move on Fuko thinking an even greater unluck will happen.
A Union member will be on the move for a UMA investigation. Andy and Fuko head towards Lake Baikal!

eps.t: Do You Love the Change in Me?
eps.ov: Gena thinks Fuko has stolen her long crush Andy and shows emotions of rivalry out of jealousy.
Andy and Fuko are taken to the Roundtable where Union members await. Apocalypse delivers new quests.
Based on Union agent reports, the town of Longing had the UMA Spoil and zombies they've created.
Fuko learns from the kids in the shelter about town's situation. Andy's gang join the zombie battle.
Spoil transitions to Phase 2, firing a decomposition laser for anything that gets away.
Victor is Andy's other face that shows up when the Card on his forehead is removed.
Apocalypse reads out the quest results. Failure of the sixth quest adds the UMA Galaxy as a penalty.
The Negator Unrepair found near a black market auction, so Andy and company head over to the venue.
The Union and the Negator Hunters infiltrated the black market auction.
While Tatiana fights members of the Negator Hunters, she receives a report that Fuko was wounded by Unrepair. Tatiana unleashes her powers in order to save Fuko!
A huge explosion occurs and sends Andy and company up into the air. They find Rip among the rubble.
Fuko and Andy head over to right outside Chikara's school to hear his reply about joining the Union.
Apocalypse reads out the quests that have the 100th penalty on the line.
To regain the Roundtable, the Union commences an operation with Andy and Fuko as central members.
The Union regains control of Apocalypse, but the Roundtable has been seized.
Fuko's bible in life, “To You, From Me”, may possibly be a story drawn out by an Artifact.
Andy and Fuko are on alert and wait for Anno Un on a bench at Stanley Park in Canada.
Andy becomes a book thanks to Autumn's claw that Anno Un materialized.
The next place Fuko arrives in the journey to learn more about Andy is Victor's memories.

eps.t: A Story I Won't See Coming
eps.ov: Anno Un's true self is Akira Kuno. Young Akira came across the Artifact, "G-Liner."
Andy's group and Rip's group collide in the fight with Autumn.
